name: robots/frankarobotics__franka_ros2
title: Franka TMR spine and battery ROS 2 interfaces
intro: Franka TMR spine and battery ROS 2 interfaces, adapted from frankarobotics/franka_ros2. It reads `position`, `position_valid`, `state`, `state_valid` and 3 more; runs `move_absolute`, `halt_motion`, `switch_off_spine`, `switch_on_spine` and 2 more. `move_absolute`: move the spine to an absolute position through the ROS 2 MoveAbsolute action; the action returns the spine's reached flag and stop reason, and cancellation requests the upstream quick-stop and re-arm path. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
